## Manuscript Figures

### Figure 1

Long term climatologies of sea-surface temperature (SST) between 1993 - 2024 (A) and forecasted SST changes under IPCC RCP Scenarios 2.6 (B) and 8.5 (C). The white contour lines represent every 5 degrees °C SST. 

![](images/plot_thetao_glorys_ssp26_ssp85_3panel_growth_rate_full_draft_ms_fig.png)
